summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Mumbai School Admissions platform. 20/20 pytest backend tests pass (schools public APIs, filters, auth, applications CRUD, favourites). Frontend: Landing, SchoolsList with filters/search, SchoolDetail, Login, Dashboard (auth-gated), Track Application submit, Manage Tracker dialog, Favourites page all working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: DEFAULT_DOCS is defined at module level with uuid.uuid4().hex generated once at import time; every new application gets the same 5 doc_ids. Recommend regenerating doc_ids inside create_application (call a factory function instead of using the module-level constant).
POST /api/applications returns model with response_model=Application but explicit pop of _id after insert_one is good; consider always projecting {'_id':0} for consistency.
schools_meta() does not filter facilities to actual seeded facilities; uses hardcoded list. Acceptable but could drift if data changes.
test_credentials: Emergent Google Auth. Test session created in MongoDB user_sessions: token=test_e2e_1778498187292, user_id=user_e2e_1778498187292.
seed_data_creation: Schools auto-seeded on startup (50 docs). Test parent user + session inserted via mongosh per /app/auth_testing.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use mongosh to insert user + session into test_database (collections users, user_sessions), then either set Cookie session_token=<token> (httpOnly, secure, sameSite=None on the preview domain) or pass Authorization: Bearer <token>. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py creates its own fresh session via mongosh fixture. AuthContext fires /api/auth/me on every page; 401 in console on unauth pages is expected.
